feeds.title: Childhood101
feeds.description: Childhood 101 was founded in 2009 by award-winning teacher and author, Christie Burnett. At Childhood 101 we are dedicated to inspiring parents, teachers and other caregivers to create playful learning opportunities in their homes and learning environments with children aged 2-12. Find activities and experiences to inspire you in your interactions with children at home, school or as a carer or educator of young children.

feeds.title: Picklebums
feeds.description: A blog about life as a mum of four in rural Australia. Featuring activities for kids, family food, gardening, gentle parenting, free printables and more.

feeds.title: The Spoke
feeds.description: Early Childhood Australia advocates to ensure quality, social justice and equity in all issues relating to the education and care of children from birth to eight years. Every young child is thriving and learning Our role in achieving this vision is to be an effective advocate for young children and a champion for quality outcomes in early childhood education and care.

feeds.title: Hello Sydney Kids
feeds.description: Find all the fun stuff to do in Sydney with your kids. With a focus on outdoor activities, Hello Sydney Kids has hundreds of ideas for activities and trips. Seana Smith came to live in Sydney with her oldest son was just 18 months old. She then set about learning all the great spots to visit with her wild child.

feeds.title: The Empowered Educator Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jode & I work with children and parents and until recently was running my own family day care business here in Australia. I am an early childhood educator and Mum. Join me for lots of play based learning info,activities &resources!

feeds.title: Mum Central » Baby Feeding
feeds.description: Mum Central is Australia's Premier Lifestyle Hub for Women, Parenting and Lifestyle, Beauty and Fashion, Food, Travel and Great Giveaways.

feeds.title: Alphabet Soup
feeds.description: Alphabet Soup magazine started in 2008. It was originally an Australian magazine for kids, now a website blog for kids who love reading & creative writing. On the website, you'll find book reviews by kids (for kids), author and illustrator interviews, and a list of writing and art competitions for kids.

feeds.title: Kidzinc Blog
feeds.description: Kidzinc provides the best educational toys, STEM resources and supplies, games, and puzzles for children. Learn how toys enhance your child's motor skills, imagination, and more by reading our blog.

feeds.title: New Born Baby
feeds.description: Newborn Baby blog is an information site for parents either trying to conceive a baby, pregnant with a baby or already enjoying their newborn child. This blog will help you to understand the journey that you are on and help you to make informed decisions along the way.

feeds.title: Kidgredients
feeds.description: Hi everyone! Welcome to Kidgredients, we're all about healthy kids food, recipes, fun lunchboxes and yummy real food. If you're looking for healthier options that are tasty and fun, you've come to the right place!

feeds.title: Travelling Australia With Kids Blog
feeds.description: Travelling Australia With Kids is the site for those thinking about, preparing or already travelling Australia with their kids. Find out all that you need to know to help you TAWK right here. Hoping to encourage others to travel Australia with their kids, this family travel blog gives you an insight on our journey.

feeds.title: Laughing Kids Learn
feeds.description: Hello and welcome! My name is Kate and I am a mum to two little girls, Possum and Boo. We have lots of fun together learning with play at home and are pleased to share some of what we do with you.

feeds.title: Life Skills 4 Kids Blog
feeds.description: Empowering parents, educators and professionals to help kids reach their potential. Deb Hopper is an Occupational Therapist passionate about helping children and adults with sensory processing disorder and learning difficulties.

feeds.title: Mum's Grapevine » Toddlers
feeds.description: Mum's Grapevine is with you every step of the way - providing the solutions, tools and clever ideas to help parents buy better and have a little fun along the way.

feeds.title: What's On 4 Kids Blog
feeds.description: What's On 4 Kids provides information about things to do and places too see for families, as well as giveaways and product reviews. Find kids activities, classes, school holidays ideas, family events and kids birthday party services. What's On 4 Kids loves encouraging Australian families to get outside and be active, explore their community and live happy and healthy lives.

feeds.title: Wildkids Australia Blog
feeds.description: Wildskids Australia offers environmental and sustainability programs for early years childcare centres and preschools throughout Australia with the aim of reconnecting children with nature.

feeds.title: Aussie Kids Adventure Camps Blog
feeds.description: Aussie Kids Adventure Camps are a child-safe, trauma informed organisation who promotes the physical and mental wellbeing of each camper and celebrates their individuality. Discovery adventures in a nurturing, safe, natural environment for children.

feeds.title: Kidsafe Australia
feeds.description: Kidsafe Australia exists to help protect children from accidental injuries. We aim to prevent road and car injuries, drownings, burns, falls, poisonings and much more. Find guides for home safety, child car seats, swimming pool security, sport and play safety and more.

feeds.title: Whole Kids Blog
feeds.description: The purpose of Whole Kids Blog is to help make it easier for mums and dads to create happy, healthy lives for their kids. At Whole Kids, they believe in healthy kids and a healthy world. So, they make their yummy snacks without any artificial preservatives, colours, flavours or other added nasties.

feeds.title: Developing Minds Blog
feeds.description: Helping kids & teens feel calm, confident, cooperative and cope with challenges. We are a group of psychologists, who specialise in working with kids, teens and young adults.

feeds.title: Where's Sharon?
feeds.description: My name is Sharon and I am passionate about family travel - so passionate that I love to share our travels and our tips to help you travel smarter, cheaper and better with your own kids. This page follows our travels with young kids and helps you to do the same!

feeds.title: OnePerfectDayBlog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome, glad you found us! We're Kate, Matt, and our 'little fire' Aiden, a family who are crazy about all things DIY. We showcase crafts, DIY projects, recipes, lots of printables, and creative inspiration for the entire family!

feeds.title: Kidspot
feeds.description: For more than 10 years Australians have turned to Kidspot to help them solve their parenting problems. With information and advice to help mums and dads through every stage - from pregnancy to parenting teens - it's no wonder that Kidspot is a trusted source for more than a million Aussies every month.

feeds.title: KidsNews
feeds.description: Kids News is a news-based literacy tool for classrooms. Covering current affairs, key curriculum topics, interesting stories about people, animals, and Australian and international sports events. News stories are also sub-categorized into key topics which include science, history, space, weather, animals, health, geography, civics, humanities, technology, environment, money, explainers, just for fun, arts, mathematics, safe kids.

feeds.title: OzLabels Blog
feeds.description: OzLabels provides personalized labels for different needs and people. We believe organising your home should be fun. With helpful and stylish stick on labels, iron on labels and sew on labels we are your one stop labelling shop!

feeds.title: Kid Magazine
feeds.description: I'm Sara Keli and I am Editor and Chief Kid at Kid Magazine. I blog, photograph, write, design, edit and make a mean cup of tea. I am a mum writing for mums who like style, pretty things and looking after themselves and their family. Kid Magazine is a parenting guide that gets it. Written by mums, for mums, it is full of inspiration and resources to help you nail your mum life.

feeds.title: Live life with your Kids Blog
feeds.description: Live life with your Kids comes with the message that parenting is about relationships with our kids, about teaching and training the heart, about using the whole of life to teach character, wisdom and life skills to our kids. Whether you are homeschooling or not, you need to be disicpling our children, living life with them with the goal of passing on values from one generation to the next.
